title: Houston COVID-19 GIS analysis, rebuilt in Python (NSF EAGER #2028612)
description:
Spatial analysis of COVID-19 across 147 Houston ZIP codes in eight regions (49,365 confirmed cases, 487 deaths), with social vulnerability, hospital access and neighbourhood connectivity.

The original was an ArcGIS Pro project carrying no local data: all 25 layers were remote services, and the one holding every COVID count has since been withdrawn, so the map could no longer be opened and replayed. This is a Python rebuild from the surviving file geodatabase, requiring no Esri licence. It is more reproducible than the original, because the eight regional definitions - previously base64-encoded lists of object IDs pointing into the dead service - are now an ordinary column.

Individual-level case records governed by the project's IRB and the Houston Health Department data-use agreement are excluded, and a test fails if any file acquires individual-level columns.

Funded by the National Science Foundation under EAGER award #2028612.
